# Cornerstone Towns Brampton — cornerstonetownsbrampton.ca

## Project Summary
Cornerstone Towns is a pre-construction master-planned community of 129 freehold townhomes in Northwest Brampton, Ontario, by Primont Homes. Located at Mississauga Road and Sandalwood Parkway West. Back-to-Back and Traditional townhome designs starting from the $600s. Includes Primont's Futura smart home technology as standard (smart thermostat, camera doorbell, motion-activated lights, USB/USB-C outlets, EV charging-ready garage). Launching Spring 2026. Future phases will include condominiums and detached homes. The community is expected to house 18,000+ people at full buildout.

## Key Facts
- Developer: Primont Homes (family-owned, 50+ years, 5,000+ homes)
- Location: Mississauga Rd & Sandalwood Pkwy W, Northwest Brampton, ON
- Units: 129 freehold townhomes (Phase 1)
- Pricing: From the $600s
- Types: 1BR+Den, 2BR, 2BR+Den, 3BR — Back-to-Back & Traditional
- Launch: Spring 2026
- Occupancy: TBD
- Smart Home: Primont Futura package (standard)
- Transit: Mount Pleasant GO Station (5 min), Züm BRT, Hwy 407/410/401, Pearson Airport (20 min)
- Schools: Aylesbury PS, Mount Pleasant Village PS, Jean Augustine SS, Sandalwood Heights SS
- Post-Secondary: Sheridan College (Davis Campus)
